claims.statement: PPWR generally applies from 12 August 2026 and covers all packaging, with requirements on composition, manufacture and recoverability.
The regulation requires conformity assessment for specified packaging requirements and an EU declaration of conformity maintained by the manufacturer.
Demand hypothesis: converters can become the distribution point because they already originate much of the material and test evidence needed for a brand's packaging file.

contrary_evidence: Some PPWR technical requirements and methods phase in later, weakening immediate urgency.
Large packaging and product-lifecycle platforms can add these fields.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: a converter deploys the shared workspace to dozens of brand customers as part of specification approval
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 150 converters averaging 60000 PLN recurring annual revenue could reach 9m PLN ARR; embedded specification switching costs could create founder equity above 5m PLN in 4-6 years
economics.founder_time: 14-20 hours weekly for one packaging format
economics.gross_margin_basis: Economics hypothesis: 78-90% after material and declaration schemas stabilise
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 9-15 months with eight converters and 2000 active specifications
economics.pricing: Economics hypothesis: 2500-10000 PLN monthly per converter plus 10-40 PLN per active specification
economics.retention_or_repeat: Material substitutions, artwork changes, supplier changes and continuing declaration updates

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A permissioned material-component evidence graph and change lineage makes repeat declarations cheaper and supplier switching safer
fingerprint.customer: EU packaging converters and consumer-goods manufacturers managing many packaging specifications
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded in converter quotation and specification-approval portals, with laboratory referrals
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Shared specification evidence workspace and release API sold as multi-tenant SaaS
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Converter or brand pays per active specification, evidence refresh and released declaration pack
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A packaging specification is approved or changed after PPWR conformity duties begin applying

founder_fit: FMCG employment provides workflow intuition without using employer-confidential information
Data modelling and change detection fit founder skills
One converter pilot can be delivered part-time
risks: Premature automation before implementing acts stabilise
Supplier confidentiality conflicts in a shared evidence graph
Liability if missing evidence is mistaken for confirmed conformity

structure.control_point: Packaging-spec approval before production and market placement
structure.critical_dependency: Implementing guidance, test evidence availability and converter participation

thesis: A packaging-converter-embedded rail could attach material, composition, test and supplier evidence to each packaging specification and generate the manufacturer's versioned conformity-declaration packet at SKU release. It would surface missing evidence, not independently determine compliance. Demand and economics are hypotheses.
title: PPWR Packaging-Spec Conformity Rail
uncertainties: Which packaging format has the highest pain now
Whether brands or converters own the budget
